# Load libraries


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
```
:::


# Load figures


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
alpha_depth <- readRDS("rds/interior_impaired/alpha_diversity_depth_plot.rds")
alpha_loc <- readRDS("rds/interior_impaired/alpha_diversity_loc_plot.rds")

beta <- readRDS("rds/interior_impaired/beta-diversity.rds")

core <- readRDS("rds/interior_impaired/upset_plot.rds")
```
:::


# Combine plots


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
alphas <- plot_grid(alpha_loc, alpha_depth,
                    labels = c("A","B"),
                    label_fontface = "bold",
                    ncol = 1, 
                    rel_heights = c(0.66, 0.33))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
beta_core <- plot_grid(beta, core,
                       labels = c("C","D"),
                       label_fontface = "bold",
                       ncol = 1,
                       rel_heights = c(0.4, 0.6))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
all <- plot_grid(alphas, beta_core,
                 ncol = 2, 
                 rel_widths = c(0.38,0.62))

all
```
